constraints.identity: Sum_tau M_tau*res_tau(Q) = [z^-1] Q[w] at z = oo
constraints.derivation: sum of the residues of a rational function on the Riemann sphere is 0

constraints.identity: deg R = Sum_tau M_tau*p_tau + g_0 + g_oo  (g = order of growth at the end, 0 if bounded)
